name: New to Grok Bot? Start Here
tagline: Set up your first bots — and learn to build your own.
rationale: The hardest part of Grok Bot is the first hour. This bundle is the on-ramp: a guided start, a bot that spawns your first useful bots, one that builds new bots from a few answers, a coach that tunes what you've got, and a vet that checks anything you install. Get running, learn to build, and stay safe doing it.

members.name: Onboarding Coach
members.reason: A guided first hour that shows a newcomer what Grok Bot can actually do for them.

members.name: Spark (Onboarding)
members.reason: Asks a few questions and spawns the starter bots that match your answers, then nudges you to connect them.

members.name: Dr Eggbot
members.reason: A bot that builds other bots: answer a handful of questions and it hands you a properly structured one.

members.name: Grok Bot Coach
members.reason: Audits and tunes the bots you already have, starting from a concrete job rather than a vague improvement.

members.name: Vet
members.reason: Audits a shared bot before you let it near your account, so 'add to Grok Bot' isn't a leap of faith.
